looks.name: Golden Portrait
looks.style: Warm, soft and flattering. Gentle contrast, smooth skin tones, calm greens.

looks.name: Sunny Gold
looks.style: Golden-yellow everyday film. Rich reds and yellows, a holiday-snapshot feel.

looks.name: Bright Landscape
looks.style: Vivid, clean and very fine grained. Bold reds and blues, made for scenery.

looks.name: Pastel Portrait
looks.style: Bright and airy pastels with minty greens and soft, cool skin.

looks.name: Soft Negative
looks.style: Muted colour with hard shadows: teal darks, warm highlights, faded greens.

looks.name: Warm Memory
looks.style: Amber highlights and soft shadows, like prints from the 70s.

looks.name: Daylight Portrait
looks.style: Clean, natural portrait film. Soft contrast, true skin tones, very fine grain.

looks.name: Everyday Green
looks.style: Classic consumer film with its famous green tint, punchy foliage and cool shadows.

looks.name: Warm Everyday
looks.style: Warm, saturated and contrasty. The go-to film for sunny days out.

looks.name: Golden Hour
looks.style: Budget film warmth: yellow-orange glow, soft shadows, a summer-afternoon feel.

looks.name: Summer Red
looks.style: Bold reds and cyan-blue skies with a slightly cool, crisp feel.

looks.name: Night Portrait
looks.style: Warm, rich portrait film for evenings and indoor light, with gentle grain.

looks.name: Cool Everyday
looks.style: Cool, slightly green budget film with soft contrast and nostalgic grain.

looks.name: Real Colour
looks.style: Accurate, natural colour with a clean, slightly cool finish.

looks.name: Muted Chrome
looks.style: Documentary-magazine look: low saturation, deep shadows, calm reds, cyan skies.

looks.name: Velvet Slide
looks.style: Very saturated landscape slide film. Deep greens and blues, strong contrast.

looks.name: Iconic Slide
looks.style: The classic magazine slide: deep reds, dark blue skies, warm mid-tones.

looks.name: Vivid Slide
looks.style: Rich, saturated landscape slide, a touch more natural than Velvet Slide.

looks.name: Clean Slide
looks.style: Clean, cool and crisp slide film with bright blues and fine grain.

looks.name: True Slide
looks.style: The standard slide film: natural but rich colour, clean contrast, true-to-life.

looks.name: Soft Slide
looks.style: Soft slide film for people: gentle contrast, smooth skin, light and clean.

looks.name: Cine Flat
looks.style: Soft cinema stock: low contrast, gentle colour and a teal shadow. Good to grade further.

looks.name: Night Tungsten
looks.style: Cool night film with red glow around lights. Made for city lights and neon.

looks.name: Clean Cinema
looks.style: Clean daylight cinema film: smooth, slightly cool, with a soft glow on bright edges.

looks.name: Cine Daylight
looks.style: Movie-film look: lifted blacks, gentle teal and orange, made to feel like a film still.

looks.name: Cinema Bleach
looks.style: Movie bleach bypass: low colour, strong contrast, a cool steely finish.

looks.name: Night Cinema
looks.style: Night movie film: cool tungsten balance, teal shadows, soft glow around lights.

looks.name: Daylight Glow
looks.style: Warm daylight cinema film: punchy colour with a soft glow on bright edges.

looks.name: Positive
looks.style: Bright, punchy and warm, with strong reds and yellows.

looks.name: Negative Snap
looks.style: Soft and slightly cool, with lifted shadows and quiet colour.

looks.name: Bleach Bypass
looks.style: Silvery, low colour and high contrast. Gritty and dramatic for action.

looks.name: Retro Snap
looks.style: Faded, warm and soft, like an old print found in a drawer.

looks.name: Cross Process
looks.style: Slide film developed the wrong way on purpose: yellow-green highlights, blue shadows, bold.

looks.name: Rangefinder Natural
looks.style: Natural and slightly warm, with rich blacks and smooth highlights.

looks.name: Rangefinder Chrome
looks.style: Cooler, cleaner and crisper, with deep blues.

looks.name: Rangefinder Classic
looks.style: Warm, soft and vintage, with gentle colour and a light vignette.

looks.name: Rangefinder Modern
looks.style: Punchy and crisp, with rich colour and deep blues.

looks.name: Silver Mono
looks.style: Smooth black and white with deep blacks and a wide range of greys.

looks.name: Fine Mono
looks.style: Very fine grain and smooth tones, with rich mid-greys.

looks.name: Classic Grain
looks.style: Gritty documentary black and white with punchy contrast and visible grain.

looks.name: Hard Mono
looks.style: Crushed blacks, bright whites and heavy grain. Bold street style.

looks.name: Street Mono
looks.style: Classic street black and white: forgiving contrast, open shadows, honest grain.

looks.name: Selenium Mono
looks.style: Black and white with cool, slightly purple selenium-toned shadows.

looks.name: Smooth Mono
looks.style: Very clean black and white: smooth tones, sharp detail, almost no grain.

looks.name: Night Mono
looks.style: Fast night black and white: big moody grain, soft shadows.

looks.name: Instant Photo
looks.style: Faded blacks, green-tinted shadows and warm, creamy highlights.

looks.name: Purple Dream
looks.style: Dreamy colour swap: greens turn purple, blues turn teal. Best on nature shots.

looks.name: Ember
looks.style: Wild new-film look: strong contrast, red-orange highlights, glowing lights and bold grain.

looks.name: Metro
looks.style: Urban look: muted greens and yellows, punchy contrast, cool and gritty.

looks.name: Cool Digicam
looks.style: The early-2000s pocket camera: cool, crisp and clean, with cyan skies and bright, hard highlights.

looks.name: Pocket Pop
looks.style: Vivid holiday snaps: rich reds, lively greens and blue skies, with punchy digital contrast.

looks.name: Soft Pixel
looks.style: Gentle and slightly magenta, with teal-green leaves and soft, airy shadows. Lovely on people.

looks.name: Crisp Contrast
looks.style: Sharp, high-contrast and saturated, with deep blacks, cool greenish shadows and bright whites.

looks.name: Party Flash
looks.style: Night-out snapshots: cool flash-lit colour, deep dark backgrounds and bright, slightly blown highlights.
